metadata.description: Marketplace hosting the OKF Knowledge Base plugin.

plugins.name: okf-knowledge-base
plugins.description: Agent-operated knowledge base on the Open Knowledge Format, run as a Karpathy-style LLM wiki: initialize domains, ingest sources (auto-routed by domain description), search, and lint — with a curator agent and a working-directory KB detector. Uses bundled pure-stdlib Python scripts.

plugins.name: okf-knowledge-base-scriptless
plugins.description: Scriptless variant of okf-knowledge-base: the skills perform initialize/ingest/search/lint directly with built-in file tools — no helper scripts, no Python dependency. Install this OR another okf-knowledge-base variant, not both (they share skill names).

plugins.name: okf-knowledge-base-powershell
plugins.description: PowerShell edition of okf-knowledge-base: the skills call bundled pwsh scripts for deterministic routing/search/lint with output identical to the Python variant. Requires PowerShell 7+. Install this OR another okf-knowledge-base variant, not both (they share skill names).
